schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Our own images. Their tags come from the chart appVersion at release time (values.yaml ships tag: ""), so Renovate must never touch them.

Majors always wait for a human, and they wait ON THE DASHBOARD, not as open PRs. The very first Renovate run surfaced 14 of them at once (web/ npm had never been covered by anything: typescript v7, vite v8, vitest v4, jsdom v30, node v24, helm v4, valkey v9, ...). Tick the box on the dependency dashboard issue to release one into a real PR.
Go module dependencies: one weekly PR, automerged once CI is green.
Go language/toolchain in go.mod. Patch level is where the crypto/tls and net/http CVE fixes land (GO-2026-5856 was exactly this) so it automerges; a language minor (1.26 -> 1.27) waits for a human.
Frontend (web/). Was covered by nobody before Renovate.
Base images in the four Dockerfiles plus the bundled valkey image in the chart values.

Tool versions pinned in a `with: version:` block: golangci-lint inside golangci-lint-action, the helm CLI inside azure/setup-helm. The github-actions manager already extracts these itself as depType uses-with (verified by a local extract dry-run), so no custom regex manager is needed and adding one would produce a second PR for the same line. A golangci-lint minor ships new linters and therefore new lint failures, and a helm minor changes chart rendering, so only patch automerges.

The groupName here is load-bearing: without it these deps keep the `github-actions` group from the rule above while carrying automerge:false, and a group is merged as a whole — one non-automergeable member parks every Action bump behind a human. Seen for real on the first run: golangci/golangci-lint and helm landed inside the github-actions group PR.
